text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After class, Agnes Digital and I grab<n>drinks for a
casual meeting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huwhaaatdhjafs?! K-karaoke?<n>W-with you?
Me???

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We've got this like free coupon<n>thing, so
we're getting a group<n>together for a Halloween
karaoke<n>party! Win-dings and Dotsy are<n>coming too!
☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The coupon covers up to six people,<n>so it'd lowkey
be a waste going with<n>just five. You can come too
if you<n>want, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Oh, sure, if you don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Aaafhdk, I'm actually here with<n>them... Omigosh
noooo, I can't believe<n>I'm literally here with them
live in<n>person I can't do thiiis!
choice_data_list: (...She says with a massive, doofy smile.)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Woo woo woooooo! Lemme get this<n>party rocking
with song numero one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Here! Y-your mic, your radiance.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gwahaha! I'm gonna make this<n>LOUD! Hey! Hey!
Heyhey!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um, you certainly are bringing the<n>energy! I-I'll
try too! Just... How are<n>you supposed to cheer for
someone<n>at karaoke? W-woo?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I brought some light sticks with me!<n>Feel free to use
them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, Doto's drink is dangerously<n>close to the
edge of the table!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Let me just scootch it over a bit for<n>her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks, Digital. You're really<n>looking out for
everyone, huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hwaa?! That's not—I wasn't... I just<n>happened to
notice, and... and!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No worries, I get it. Helios knocks<n>drinks over all the
time, so I just<n>kinda naturally keep an eye out now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I feel like you and I have a lot in<n>common. Like
we're always<n>watching everyone else, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyah?! Me? A lot? In common with<n>you? I-I don't
even know what to<n>say, but I guess I do find you
pretty<n>relatable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah... I feel like seeing other people<n>happy makes
Palmer happy too...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold up! I just<n>realized—Digiridoo hasn't
sung<n>anything yet! C'mon girl, don't leave<n>us
hanging!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're right! I'm so sorry, I didn't<n>notice we'd
been hogging the mic.<n>What would you like to sing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I couldn't possibly! Don't<n>mind me, I'm
just here to listen!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Cut out the shy crap and sing<n>something for us!
Now!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Aaashdgjk, I'm not being shy, perse... It's just—there's plenty ofotaku-y songs I can sing, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But those would only be fun for me! Idon't know any normie songs thateveryone would enjoy, so really, I'mfine!
choice_data_list:
You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have
some fun!

You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have
some fun!

I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you
like!

I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you
like!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But those would only be fun for me! Idon't know any normie songs thateveryone would enjoy, so really, I'mfine!
choice_data_list:
You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have
some fun!

You're part of "everyone" too, you know. Have
some fun!

I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you
like!

I'm sure we're all curious what kind of music you
like!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...! You really mean it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Duh! We're friends, right? If you're<n>not having fun,
neither are we!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uuuahdjhg... Well, if you put it like<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll guess I'll go ahead and put in a<n>song I love. If
that's okay?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, though, my favorite<n>thing is seeing all
my oshi<n>Umamusume having a blast!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So all I've gotta do is sing something<n>that gets
Umas pumped! Something<n>my idols would have fun
singing!<n>Right?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Okay, get ready! Here comes theUmamusume song! The eternal Umasimp anthem!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Umadacchi! ♪ Oooh! Umapyoi!<n>Umapyoi! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Sukidacchi! Oooooh! Umapoi! ♪<n>Uma uma
umya unya—3, 2, 1, fight! ♪

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: WOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it! There's not an<n>Umamusume alive who
doesn't get<n>hyped for Umapyoi! They're all so
adorable, cheering along!)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Everyone had a great time—Agnes<n>Digital included.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
You... you are?! But why would my<n>oshis want to
know about me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Although... They may be oshis to me,<n>but to them...
I'm another student at<n>their school. A friend.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Inhale... Whew. I am but a humblesimp, but for all of you, I'll steel myresolve.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's usually against fangirl code to<n>bombard others
with nerd talk, but if<n>you're curious, I'll sing you the
song<n>of my people!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I feel like I've heard this before. It<n>was a big hit
decades ago, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Decades ago?! You mean it's older<n>than I am?!
Digital, you weren't even<n>born when this song
came out!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to explain during the<n>bridge—you're both
right! This song is<n>a classic that's been covered
over<n>the years, trending time and time<n>again with
new lyrics!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It started out as a song to cheer for a<n>certain
Umamusume racer, but one of<n>the band members
had a bad habit of<n>being late, so the song evolved
into a<n>silly way to hurry him up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Omg this song highkey<n>slaps! The lyrics
and beat are so fast!<n>Run, run, Umamusume! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm digging it too! I'm preeetty<n>sure my
grandma has a copy of the<n>original record lying
around.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Oh my glob, really?! But it's so rare!<n>That's the
Mejiro family for you!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The song really breaks the ice, and<n>they continue
chatting afterwards.<n>The karaoke party ends up
being a<n>blast!
